desks.summary: The central bank hikes 100 bps to defend the pound; Alphabet's fall hits big tech.
Chipmakers lead the Nasdaq's worst month since March 2025; the EGX reopens Sunday after the rate hike.
The EGX reopens after the rate hike with EGP 110bn of bills at auction; Apple's results test a battered Nasdaq.
The EGX30 falls 1.7% on its first session after the hike; Banque du Caire debuts and Apple's results test a battered Nasdaq.
The EGX30 hits its lowest close since April as Banque du Caire opens flat; Apple slides on guidance and Oracle's $20bn raise hits chips.
The EGX30 rebounds 1.8% as foreigners buy; a 20% gas cut hits fertiliser stocks; Democrats take the Senate and Treasury yields near 5%.
The EGX30 jumps 2.8% on foreign buying as the pound firms and Brent falls 9%; the Dow has its best day since April 2025 after Democrats win Congress.
The pound firms for a sixth session to EGP 54.01 and the EGX30 adds 1%; Wall Street's worst day since April 2025 sends the Nasdaq into a correction and chips down 12%.
Inflation eases to 12% and Egypt's real yield widens to about 14 points before Sunday's reopening; in the US, a 165,000-job surprise revives December hike bets as chips bounce.
Goldman calls the pound 30% undervalued as Cairo rations its dollars; Berkshire buys back a record $9.6bn before Tuesday's US inflation test.
Gas cuts deepen to 33% and knock fertilizer stocks; Egypt Aluminium's profit doubles; Nvidia's board opens an inquiry into Huang before results.
CIB's nine-month profit edges up to EGP 63.1bn and inflation slows to 12.7%; Nvidia sinks as Wall Street rebounds before CPI.
The pound hits a one-year high on foreign bill buying and record remittances; a hot US CPI locks in a December Fed hike.
Telecom Egypt's profit rises 44% and MSCI adds it to its Egypt index; Nvidia sinks 8.6% after hours as its board weighs removing Huang.
Huang quits Nvidia as US yields hit 5.1%; Egypt's bills draw 2.8 times cover and the pound firms.
